Recovery

Recover your Breez app

This tool restores the backup the Breez app kept in your cloud account and moves the funds to a bitcoin address of your choice. It runs a copy of your Breez app node on this computer, so keep it open until the steps are done.

Still have the Breez app on your phone? Make a safety copy first: open the menu, then Developers, then Export DB Files, and keep the zip somewhere safe. You will not need it here, but it holds everything the app knows in case something goes wrong.
  1. Find your backup in Google Drive, iCloud or a backup file.
  2. Sync the restored app with the bitcoin network. First time takes a while.
  3. Move the funds by closing your channels to an address you control.

Continue your recovery

A Breez app restored earlier is on this computer. Continue to sync it and move the funds, or restore another backup.
